The meluna runs cheap for the menstrual cup market at about 15 bucks on most sites. There are other small cups out there though, and bell shaped cups allow your cervix to sit inside the cup. If you can fit in about a knuckle and a half to two knucles on your middle finger in before you feel your cervix, these cups should work very well. If you're tight I recommend feeling around up "there" to see if you can feel pressure on your bladder easily, as a really firm cup can irritate that, but otherwise, vaginal nerves only go up about half an inch into the vagina until you reach the cervix, which you may feel a little bit. A cup with a flared rim will sit up higher on the cervix comfortably, and those options are: Lena, Amycup, Sckoon cup, fleur, and Si-bell. The Casco cup mini is also quite short.
